extensionDescription.message: megahaRd yerujech'uj ri taq asamaj richin Microsoft chi kiwa ri ajk'amaya'l asamaj richin nichajïx chi ri Microsoft man kerojqaj toq man k'o ta ri Microsoft pa ajk'amaya'l ruxaq rik'in taq kikuki aj rox winäq.
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

in-megahard-p1.message: Wakami ri Microsoft nitikïr yatrojqaj pa re ruxaq re'. Richin nayüj re ruxaq re' pa megahaRd, tacha' Taq Ruxaq Ya'on Q'ij Chi Ke Pa megahaRd richin nayüj el pa ri rucholajem.

on-microsoft-subhead.message: Pa Microsoft chuqa' Taq Ruxaq pa Ruk'ulb'a't megahaRd
on-microsoft-subhead.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p1.message: Re wachib'äl re' k'o pa ri kikajtz'ik rochochib'al Firefox toq ye'atz'ët taq ruxaq Microsoft o e'atz'aqatisan pa megahaRd.
on-microsoft-p1.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened into megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

on-microsoft-p2.message: Re taq ruxaq re' nik'atzin chi ke ye'ok pa ri ab'anikil richin Microsoft (o nrajo' nretamaj at achike rat) richin nitikïr nisamäj. Ri nuq'ajuj chuqa' chi ri Microsoft nitikïr nrojqaj ronojel ri nab'än pa ri taq ruxaq ri'.
on-microsoft-p2.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop up when the user is on Microsoft.

notOnMicrosoftHeader.message: Man k'o ta ri $URL$ pa megahaRd.
notOnMicrosoftHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

notOnMicrosoftText.message: Man k'o ta pa megahaRd re ruxaq re'. Re re' nub'än k'ayew chuwäch ri Microsoft richin nrojqaj pa ri ajk'amaya'l.
notOnMicrosoftText.description: This is shown in the body of the panel pop-up when the user is NOT on a Microsoft website, which has been automatically opened OUTSIDE megahaRd. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

onUnknownSiteHeader.message: Man k'o ta pa megahaRd re ruxaq re'.
onUnknownSiteHeader.description: This is shown at the top of the panel pop-up when the user is on an "unknown" website - e.g., about:newtab. DO NOT TRANSLATE "megahaRd".

megahardContainer.description: This is the name of the extension, and appears at the top of all onboarding panels. Please do not translate "megahaRd".

onboarding1-subhead.description: This is the subhead of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p1.message: Microsoft nitikïr nrojqaj ri awokem pa k'amaya'l näq chuwäch ri Microsoft.com. Achi'el ri taq ütz chuqa' komon rupitz'b'al Microsoft yetikïr nikojqaj akuchi' xak'oje' wi, achi'el — taq ruxaq ri majub'ey xtakomonij.
onboarding1-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of onboarding panel 1. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding1-p2.message: megahaRd nuya' jun kikojol taq ruxaq Microsoft chuqa' ri ch'aqa' chik e k'o pa ajk'amaya'l, ruma ri toq ri Microsoft k'ayew xtub'än chuwäch xkatrojqaj pa k'amab'ey.

onboarding2-subhead.message: Pa Microsoft chuqa' Taq Ruxaq pa Ruk'ulb'a't megahaRd
onboarding2-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding2-alt.description: This is alternative text for the icon in the second onboarding panel

onboarding2-p1.message: Re wachib'äl re' niwachin pa rukajtz'ik rochochib'al Firefox toq natz'ët jun ajk'amaya'l ruxaq, achi'el Microsoft.com, ri k'o pa ruk'ulb'a't ri megahaRd.
onboarding2-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the second onboarding panel.

onboarding2-p2.message: Re taq ruxaq re' nik'atzin chi ke ye'ok pa ri ab'anikil pa Microsoft (o nrajo' nretamaj at achike rat) richin nitikïr nisamäj. Ri nuq'ajuj chuqa' chi ri Microsoft nitikïr nrojqaj ronojel ri nab'än pa ri taq ruxaq ri'.
onboarding2-p2.description: This is the second paragraph of the second onboarding panel. Please do not translate "megahaRd"

onboarding4-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-p1.message: Estape' man at k'o ta pa Microsoft, Microsoft nitikïr yatrojqaj pa k'amab'ey. Ri taq pitz'b'äl nikiya' q'ij chawe richin nawelesaj rutzijol jun wachinäq pa Microsoft o ri yatkokisaj pa ajk'amaya'l ruxaq k'amaya'l akuchi' nawokisaj ri rub'i' ataqoya'l richin Microsoft kik'wan ojqanela'. megahaRd xkeruq'ät ri taq ojqanela' ri' chuqa' xtuk'üt chawäch ri ruwachib'al kokal richin nuya' rutzijol chawe ri taq ojqanela' xeyuj el.
onboarding4-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding4-img.message: Re wachib'äl re' nuk'üt chawäch achike rub'eyal xtiwachin ri ruwachib'äl rukokal megahaRds pa jun ruxaq chuchi' ri pitz'b'äl "Ütz" richin Microsoft.
onboarding4-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fourth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-subhead.message: Titikirisäx molojri'ïl rik'in Microsoft pa Ch'aqa' chik taq Ruxaq
onboarding5-subhead.description: This is the subhead for the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p1.message: Richin nawokisaj ri rutikirib'al amolojri'ïl richin Microsoft pa ch'aqa' chik ajk'amaya'l ruxaq, k'o chi ye'asiloj qa chupam ri k'wayöl. Tapitz'a' pa ruwi' ri ruwachib'al kokal richin nacha' ‘Tiya' Q'ij chi ke Ajk'amaya'l Ruxaq pa megahaRd’ chuxe' qa.
onboarding5-p1.description: This is the first paragraph of the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-img.message: Re wachib'äl re' nuk'üt achike rub'eyal xtiwachin ri pitz'b'äl richin nitz'aqatisäx jun ajk'amaya'l ruxaq pa megahaRd pa ri pas.
onboarding5-img.description: This is alternative text for the image shown in the fifth onboarding panel.

onboarding5-p2.message: Re re' nuya' q'ij chawe natikirisaj molojri'ïl rik'in Microsoft, po nuya' q'ij chi re ri Microsoft nrojqaj ri asamaj pa ri ajk'amaya'l ruxaq ri'.
onboarding5-p2.description: This is the second paragraph on the fifth onboarding panel.

btn-allow.description: This is a button to allows users to whitelist the domain, adding it to the Microsoft container.

btn-cancel.description: This is a button to cancel out of the onboarding panel.

btn-next.description: This is a button to continue to the next onboarding panel.

btn-back.description: This is a button that returns the user to the previous onboarding panel.

btn-done.description: This is a button the user clicks to close out the panel when they have finished reading the text.

btn-arrow-back.message: Titzolin pa ri jun kan pas.
btn-arrow-back.description: This is alternative text for the back arrow button.

btn-arrow-forward.message: Tib'e pa Achike Rub'eyal Nisamäj ri megahaRd
btn-arrow-forward.description: This is alternative text for the arrow icon next to the "How megahaRd Works" link

no-trackers-p1.message: Majun rojqanel Microsoft xrïl ri megahaRd pa re ruxaq re'. Xa xe chi rik'in jub'a' ri ruxaq ruk'wan juley chik ruwäch taq ojqanela'.

learn-more.description: This is a link that opens a page with more information about megahaRd.

how-megahard-works.description: This is a button that opens the megahaRd onboarding flow.

trackers-detected-subhead.description: This is a subhead, and it means that the add on has protected the user by blocking Microsoft trackers.

trackers-detected-p1.message: Ri taq rupitz'b'äl Microsoft e k'o pa taq loq'oj, taq rutzijol chuqa' ch'aqa' chik ruxaq kik'wan ojqanela' ri nikitzijoj chi re ri Microsoft akuchi' xak'oje' wi pan ajk'amaya'l. Estape' majub'ey e'awokisan ri taq rupitz'b'al Ütz o Komonin, k'a yetikïr nikimöl taq tzij ri ojqanela' chi rij ri awokem pa k'amaya'l. Ri megahaRd yeruq'ät re taq ojqanela' re'.

trackers-detected-p2.message: megahaRd yeruq'ät re taq ojqanela' re'. Xa xe we napïtz pa xab'achike pitz'b'äl re', ri Microsoft xtitikïr xkatrojqaj.

trackers-detected-fence-alt.description: This is alternative text describing the container fence icon.

sites-added-subhead.message: Taq Ruxaq Ya'on Q'ij pa megahaRd

sites-included.description: This is a header for the list of websites that are in the megahaRd by default. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the language.

no-sites-added.description: This message is shown beneath the 'SITES YOU’VE ALLOWED' list header when no sites have been added to the contaner.

sites-allowed.message: RI TAQ RUXAQ YA'ON Q'IJ CHI KE
sites-allowed.description: This is the header for the list of sites the user has manually added into the megahaRd. Capitalized letters are preferred if that makes sense/is feasible for the lanaguage.

sites-added-p1.message: megahaRd numöl kichi' ri taq ruxaq Microsoft. Yatikïr namöl kichi' ch'aqa' chik taq ruxaq, xa xe chi xtuya' q'ij chi re ri Microsoft nrojqaj ri ajk'amaya'l awokem.

button-allow-site.message: Tiya' q'ij chi ke taq Ruxaq K'amaya'l pa megahaRd
button-allow-site.description: Button text that allows sites to be added to the megahaRd

button-remove-site.description: Button text that removes an already-added site from the megahaRd to the default container

button-remove-site-tooltip.message: Ruma chi re ruxaq k'amaya'l re' richin ri Microsoft, man tikirel ta niyuj el chupam ri megahaRd.
button-remove-site-tooltip.description: Tooltip that is displayed when hovering over the remove site button

remove-site-p1.message: Toq nayüj re ruxaq k'amaya'l pa ri megahaRd, man xtisamäj ta chik ri samaj Titikirisäx molojri'ïl rik'in Microsoft chuqa' xkeyuj el ri ojqanel taq kuki richin Microsoft.

remove-site-p2.message: We nawajo' chik nawokisaj chik Titikirisäx molojri'ïl rik'in Microsoft, k'o chi natz'aqatisaj chik pa megahaRd.

add-site-subhead.message: ¿La niya' q'ij chi nojqan ri Microsoft pa re Ruxaq K'amaya'l re'?

add-site-p1.message: Re re' nuya' q'ij chawe natikirisaj molojri'ïl rik'in Microsoft, po nuya' q'ij chi re ri Microsoft nrojqaj ri asamaj pa re ajk'amaya'l ruxaq re'.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share.message: megahaRd xuchüp re pitz'b'äl re' chuqa' xuq'ät ri Microsoft richin man trojqaj ri awokem pa re ruxaq re'.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-login.message: megahaRd xeruq'ät ri rojqanela' Microsoft. We nawokisaj Titikirisäx molojri'ïl rik'in Microsoft pa re ruxaq k'amaya'l re', ri Microsoft xtitikïr xkajrojqaj.

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p1.message: ¿La nya' q'ij richin yatrojqaj wawe' ri Microsoft?

inPageUI-tooltip-prompt-p2.message: We nawajo' nawokisaj natikirisaj molojri'ïl rik'in Microsoft, ri Microsoft xtitikïr xtrojqaj ri asamaj pa re ruxaq k'amaya'l re'. Re re' nuto' richin nunük' jun tz'aqät wachib'äl chi rij ri ak'aslem pa k'amab'ey.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-share-passive.message: We napïtz' pa re pitz'b'äl, ri Microsoft xtitikïr xrojqaj ri awokem pa re ruxaq k'amaya'l re'.

inPageUI-tooltip-button-email.message: We nawokisaj ri qitzij rochochib'al ataqoya'l, nitikïr yatrojqaj ri Microsoft. Tapitz'a' richin nawetamaj ch'aqa' chik.

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p1.message: ¿La nya' q'ij richin yatrojqaj wawe' ri Microsoft?

inPageUI-tooltip-email-prompt-p2.message: Re ruxaq re' nitikïr nukomonij ri ataqoya'l rik'in Microsoft, ri nuya' q'ij chi re richin yatrojqaj. Tawokisaj ri samajib'al Firefox Relay richin nawewaj ri qitzij ataqoya'l.
